text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While we're training in preparation for
the
Hopeful Stakes...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Uphill...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Hopeful Stakes is a 2,000-meter
turf race held at Nakayama Racecourse.
The starting line is
on a straight right
before a slope.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Runners have to climb the same slope
twice, right after the start and just
before the finish, a
challenge for
inexperienced junior racers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She'll have a better chance if she focuses
on the second pass, during her last
spurt, rather than the
initial jostling for
position.
choice_data_list: On the first run, get a feel for t...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Get a feel for it...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Uh, meaning what, exactly?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: My stride?
choice_data_list: Make sure you know your stride len...
Make sure you know your stride len...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've come up with a strategy for the
Hopeful
Stakes, but I'm having trouble
explaining it
clearly.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Which part? Uhh...
choice_data_list: What part was hard to follow?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Like... all of it?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm just, you know... not, like,
great with

strategies...
choice_data_list: I see...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Yeah, I get that much. I might be dumb, but I'm not that dumb.
choice_data_list: You know you'll be climbing the hi...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: A test run?
choice_data_list: So the first hill is just to test ...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take her to a riverside slope to show
her what I
mean.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Uhh, sure, I guess...
choice_data_list: Try climbing with longer strides t...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Well?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, come on. You should've warned me I
was
gonna have to do it twice.
choice_data_list: Next, keep it quick, to a rat-a-ta...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her complaining, Tosen Jordan
makes a
spirited dash up the hill.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...It felt easier than the first time, I
think?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh, yeah? Huh.
choice_data_list: It's easier to climb a hill with s...
It's easier to climb a hill with s...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She looks surprised, but she already
does it
unconsciously on the training
course.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's just that on unfamiliar terrain, like
this slope by the river, she has no way of
knowing how to
adjust her stride
beforehand.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Because the hill at Nakayama and the
one at
school are different?
choice_data_list: I think that's how it'll go in the...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Different inclines require different
strides. The
only way to figure out the
best approach is to
actually run it.
choice_data_list: Right, that's why we're testing it...
Right, that's why you have to try ...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Hopeful Stakes is here.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So the first time up the slope is the test
run.
That's where I figure out the best
way to run up.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Then, when I go up the second
time—when it
really counts—I book it!
That about right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Got it! That's what I'll do!
choice_data_list: That's it!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
I've gotta take first if I wanna
make it
big.
choice_data_list: That got you fired up, too.
That got you fired up, too.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, the Classic Triple Crown is a
must, which
means I've gotta deal with
the Satsuki next, you
know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Geez, what are you shouting for? Trying
to blow
my ears out or something?
choice_data_list: You've already decided on your nex...
You've already decided on your nex...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As far as I knew, she never had any goal
besides
"making it big."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For her to name the Classic Triple Crown

specifically like that, she must have
been doing
some research.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Ahhh!
choice_data_list: ...So you've been studying on your...
...So you've been studying on your...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whatever! First things first, I have the
Hopeful to
win, so see ya!
